title: Meet a Scientific Paper: Article Types and IMRAD
objective: Students learn the main parts of a biology research article and what each section does.
context: Classroom text: We asked where snails were common. We counted snails by two ponds. Pond A had eight and Pond B had three. The banks may differ in shade.

items.prompt: Which sentence belongs in Methods? Explain your choice.
items.answer: We counted snails by two ponds. It tells what the team did.
items.hint: Look for what the team did.

items.prompt: Give one result. Name the section where a reader would find it.
items.answer: Pond A had eight snails and Pond B had three; Results.

items.prompt: Which section gives a possible reason for the result? Give the possible reason in this text.
items.answer: Discussion; the banks may differ in shade.
